recentItems.title: Education: We have a Problem | Make Word Not War | Ep 4 | Rascalas + War Horse
recentItems.description:
With over 60℅ of engineering graduates unemployed in our country, we can't help but wonder, did they really want to become engineers when they were growing up?

The Indian education system has been openly criticised for testing a student's memory and not a student's skill. What ever happened to following your passion and taking over the world?

The academy is a discovery based education system designed to help people speak better, think better and know more. It consists of a core curriculum and a range of very interesting electives.
